sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all allies. Increases time elemental attack by 8 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
[Unison Effect Boost] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
